notes: the chain as written ends at Ibn Abbas; inside his story Ubayy b. Ka'b answers «نعم سمعت رسول الله» and may be the last link (rule 6), but the text does not settle whether he is the source or a figure in the story, so he is not added
«أبي» with no name is a relation; «- قال ابن عباس هو خضر -» and the Qur'anic quotation are matn, not links
